resources.string: Add a widget to your homescreen and edit the settings here afterward!\n\n If you don’t know how then take a look at the info screen.
How do I add a widget to my homescreen?

1. Touch and hold an empty area on your home screen until a menu appears.
 2. Look for "Widgets" in that menu.
 3. Find Widget App in the list, then touch and hold the widget you want.
 4. Drag it to the spot on your home screen where you want it, and release.
Steps can vary slightly depending on your phone brand. If this doesn’t quite match your device, search online for "how to add a widget on [your phone brand]" for exact instructions.
